title: Design a separate records history and propose the decision
summary: Write a design-only document, docs/design/records-history.md, for moving Athena's records into their own history. Add a Proposed entry to docs/decisions.md for Sri to decide. The design covers all seven required points, from the options comparison to the build plan and reversal cost.

defaults_applied.how: Design written with alternatives before any build; decision left Proposed.
Claims cite sources; numbers measured or labeled estimates.
Criteria check the design's content and that no code changed.
No secrets or personal data, no email addresses.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: a design for Sri (owner) to decide on; the audience is Sri and later producers who build it.
Existing docs/decisions.md format and the next free decision number are followed; I did not open the files, so the producer must read them.
Claims about the history check, trailers, and the exempt entries are cited from the repo (athena.toml, xtask, BRIEF.md) by the producer, with measured numbers or labeled estimates.
No athena.toml change is made now; the design only proposes changes for the later build jobs.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/records-history.md compares at least three options (records branch with a separate root in this repo, a second repository, a database), each weighed against BRIEF.md A4, A5 and D72, and recommends exactly one with reasons.

The design migrates every existing record, states what happens to records/ on main afterwards, and states how the history check treats commits before the cutover (including the six [history] exempt entries and 02837e0).

The design attributes each main commit from records alone, with no commit-message trailers. It names the records written after the merge (PR head, host-made commit). It gives the pull-request-level squash rule and says how PR commits stay reachable without the host.
A table lists each current guarantee (append-only, nothing unverified reaches main, prediction precedes outcome, secrets and personal data) with where it is enforced after the change.
The design covers crash reconciliation between host merge and record write, and parallel writers to the records history.
The design makes the check's cost depend on new commits only (since last passing state) with a periodic full replay, and says how that is measured against today's ~65 s / ~4,000 records.
The design gives an ordered build plan of jobs, each sized for one producer run, in which main is never unattributed, and states the reversal cost.

docs/decisions.md has a new entry with status Proposed (not Accepted) summarising the recommendation and alternatives, in the file's existing format and numbering, for Sri to decide; no existing entry is altered.
No code, athena.toml, defaults.toml, or workflow files change: git diff --stat lists only docs/design/records-history.md and docs/decisions.md.

out_of_scope: Any code, xtask, or athena.toml change
Accepting the decision or starting the migration
Rewriting or deleting existing records or history
departures: Large multi-part design requiring reading BRIEF.md, xtask history check and decisions; costs somewhat above the reference.
